verdict: Local presence is active and growing; paid ads remain paused this period.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all activity came through organic channels — paid advertising on Meta and Google was not running, so there are no paid leads or spend to report. Your Google Business Profile was the clear mover, generating 66 actions including 39 direction requests and 26 website clicks, a 27% jump over the prior week, which points to real local search interest finding you without paid support. Website sessions totaled 174 over the period, running roughly flat week over week with no strong upward trend building yet. The direction requests in particular suggest people are actively looking for your location, which is a meaningful signal for a local service business.
